rationale: 11e 20.01 caps Strategic Reserves at half the army's starting points, and the practical cap is much lower: units in reserve score nothing and contest nothing while they wait. A 950-point reserve declaration lost a benchmark game outright (docs/AI_REVIEW_2026-07-11.md 2.4). This exam runs a LIVE formations phase (the fixture starts at phase 0 with nothing pre-confirmed — every earlier fixture auto-completed it, so the AI's declaration code had never once executed in an automated game) and checks the AI's own declaration keeps reserves at or under 50% of army points. The status test uses the integer enum (IN_RESERVES == 7) — the old string compare could never match anything a phase writes, which pinned 'reserved' at 0.0 and made the exam unfailable.

assert.name: reserved points stay within the 11e 50% cap
the formations phase actually ran for player 1 (confirmed flag set)
